lines.text: The LORD sends Assyria, the rod of His anger, against a godless nation, though Assyria plans to destroy many nations.
Assyria asks whether Samaria is like Damascus, and says he will do to Jerusalem what he did to Samaria.
After His work against Mount Zion and Jerusalem, the Lord will punish Assyria's king for his arrogant heart.
The king of Assyria boasts that by his own strength and wisdom he gathered all the earth like abandoned feathers.
The Lord GOD of Hosts sends a wasting disease among Assyria's warriors, and the Light of Israel becomes a shield.
